messages:
Marta: Hey team — need to swap my Sun 14:00-22:00 PST oncall. Flight rerouted, can take Mon 18:00-02:00 instead if someone covers the slot. Leaving a few prewarm/runbook notes below. Short notice, sorry :airplane:
Liam: I can cover 14:00-18:00 PST but I have a meeting 18:00-19:00. Who can pick up 19:00-22:00?
Josh: I can do 19:00-22:00. Marta — please drop any runbook steps and any known risks (deploys, cache cold starts).
Marta: Thanks both. Quick notes: there is a non-prod model rollout scheduled at 15:30 (shouldn't touch prod infra) but watch latency. Runbook snippet below — run prewarm ~15m before start.
Marta: ```
# Prewarm runbook (summary)
1) SSH to warm host: gcloud compute ssh oncall-warm
2) Run warm: ./prewarm.sh --models rdx-25b --tokens 4096
3) Tail metrics: kubectl logs -f svc/predictor --since=1m | grep latency
4) If 95p latency > 300ms -> run fallback: ./fallback.sh --model rdx-13b
5) KV cache: check hit-rate: curl http://metrics/api/cache/hit-rate | jq
```
Marta: Also note: prefix caching sometimes needs manual prime if pool scale-to-zero happened. I left an env override: export MODEL_POOL=rdx_prod_pool on the warm host.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled rollout "model-rolling" at 15:30 UTC by release-bot. No infra changes expected.
Anita: Quick timezone check — Marta said PST. For clarity: 14:00 PST = 22:00 UTC, is that correct? I can help late-night UTC if needed.
Josh: Correct, 14:00 PST = 22:00 UTC. Also add: autoscaler threshold is 45k QPS for horizontal autoscale — if we see sudden 5x QPS, expect partial throttling until pools spin up. Keep an eye on queue length.
Liam: I'll do an initial prewarm at 13:45 PST (so pools are hot by 14:00). @Josh please plan to join at 18:50 to full handoff. Marta — where's the prewarm script located?
Marta: Path is /home/oncall/scripts/prewarm.sh on the warm host. I also added a small check in the script to verify KV hit-rate > 85% before returning success.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: model-rolling (non-prod) queued at 15:30 UTC; maintained by release-bot. No infra scale policies changed.
Josh: Got it — I'll take 19:00-22:00. Marta, please confirm whether any dedicated-customer routes are pinned to a smaller model during this window (affects SLA behavior). Also share pager escalation list if possible.
Marta: Confirmed — dedicated customers are pinned to rdx-13b during this maintenance window by policy, SLA unaffected. Pager escalation: primary = oncall-ops (pagerduty), secondary = infra-lead. I DM'ed the full list to @Josh.
Liam: Sounds good. I'll post a short handoff message at 13:50 PST with current pool sizes, recent deployments, and last KV hit-rate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Josh: Confirmed acceptance for 19:00-22:00. Thanks @Marta and @Liam — appreciate the clear notes. :raised_hands:
